task.final_summary: The stopwatch is paused. It was idle at zero when I opened it, so I started it, let it run a couple of seconds, and pressed Pause. It now holds at 02.36 with a Start button showing, and the reading stayed frozen across two checks, confirming it is not running.

steps.note: Observe the screen to find the stopwatch app state
Open the Clock app and go to its stopwatch tab
Tap the Stopwatch tab and check its state
Re-read the stopwatch screen to see if the timer is running
Start the stopwatch, then pause it so it holds a paused state
Tap Pause and verify the stopwatch is paused
Confirm the stopwatch stays paused and finish
